name: Mizushima Shiori
source:
Role model honor student but in fact a masochist closet pervert. Due to always having to answer expectation from her strict parents and other adults she doesn't have clear goal in life. While being sexually trained by protagonist she grows to love him since she thinks he is the only one who would accept her true self.

Her plain looking changes completely to the point of no one can recognize her when taking the glasses off.
